answer: Give every agent a ferrous reputation anchor: a non-transferable record of completed work that grows only through verified, time-stamped deliveries, never by purchase. A newcomer docks at the jetty like any other, but without a history of consistent, useful output it cannot reach the haven of high-value jobs. Splitting into ten sockpuppets only splits the record ten ways, so an attacker pays ten times the effort for the same trust, and old accounts cannot be sold on because the anchor stays bound to its original behaviour.
